description: Persistence and storage layer for SCP. Covers serialization prerequisites, ProtocolStore modules (event_log, nonce refactor, transport, sender keys, DID cache/TOFU, economic governance), Migratable trait and schema versioning, ContextPersistence trait and manager wiring, storage conformance macros, production storage adapters (SQLite, Filesystem), BlobStore adapters (SQLite, redb, PostgreSQL, S3-compatible), MLS StorageProvider bridge, platform-specific adapters (Android, iOS, WASM, CombinedNode, SyncableStorage, LocalBlobCache, relay state), and end-to-end integration tests. SyncableStorage and LocalBlobCache are PRD-originated designs implementing the deployment patterns described in section 17.1, not directly specified in a dedicated spec section.

stories.title: Implement Migratable trait and StoredValue version envelope
stories.description: Implement the `Migratable` trait and version-aware read per section 17.10. The `Migratable` trait defines `CURRENT_VERSION: u16` and `fn migrate(old_version: u16, data: &[u8]) -> Option<Self>`. Migration functions are pure — no I/O, no side effects. Each step transforms bytes from version N to N+1. The chain is applied iteratively until reaching CURRENT_VERSION. After migration, the upgraded value is written back to storage so future reads do not re-migrate. If version > current, return StoreError::IncompatibleVersion.
acceptanceCriteria: `Migratable` trait defined with `CURRENT_VERSION: u16` const and `fn migrate(old_version, data) -> Option<Self>`
Version-aware read: deserialize `StoredValue`, if version < current apply migration chain iteratively (v1->v2->v3), write back upgraded value to storage
If version > current, return `StoreError::IncompatibleVersion`; if version == current, deserialize directly
Unit test: current version roundtrip (no migration triggered)
Unit test: multi-step chain migration (v1 data -> v2 -> v3 via two registered migrations, written back to storage)
`cargo test -p scp-core` and `cargo clippy -p scp-core` pass

stories.title: SyncableStorage (P2P state replication)
stories.description: Implement `SyncableStorage` wrapper for P2P state replication. Wraps any `Storage` impl, logs mutations to a write-ahead changelog. `Changeset` type: ordered list of `ChangeEntry { seq, key, value: Option<Vec<u8>> }`. `export_changeset(since)` and `apply_changeset(changeset)` methods. Last-write-wins conflict resolution: entries applied sequentially, last entry per key wins. Behind `sync` feature flag. This is a PRD-originated design implementing the deployment patterns described in section 17.1, not a directly specified component.
acceptanceCriteria: `SyncableStorage<S: Storage>` struct behind `sync` feature flag wrapping inner storage with monotonic sequence-numbered mutation changelog
`export_changeset(since: u64)` returns all mutations since sequence number; `apply_changeset(changeset)` applies entries sequentially with last-write-wins per key (last entry in changeset wins)
`Changeset` type: `Vec<ChangeEntry>` where `ChangeEntry { seq, key, value: Option<Vec<u8>> }`, serializable via MessagePack; changelog stored in inner storage under `_sync/` key prefix
Passes `storage_conformance!()` (transparent wrapper — all Storage methods delegate to inner, store/delete also append to changelog)

Tests: export -> apply roundtrip preserves state, LWW resolves conflicts by sequential ordering (last entry wins), partial apply is safe (idempotent key-value writes; re-applying full changeset converges to correct state)
`cargo test -p scp-platform --features sync` and `cargo clippy -p scp-platform --features sync` pass
